fields.objective: Detect and quantify specific protein expression using immunoblotting
fields.materials:
- Protein samples
- Protein ladder/marker
- SDS-PAGE gel (or materials to cast gel)
- Running buffer
- Transfer buffer
- PVDF or nitrocellulose membrane
- Blocking buffer (5% milk or BSA in TBST)
- Primary antibody
- Secondary antibody (HRP-conjugated)
- ECL substrate
- TBST (Tris-buffered saline with Tween-20)
- Imaging system

protocol.description:
Sample Preparation:
  - Determine protein concentration (Bradford or BCA assay)
  - Prepare samples to equal concentration
  - Add loading buffer (4x) and DTT or β-mercaptoethanol
  - Heat samples at 95°C for 5 minutes
  - Cool and centrifuge briefly

SDS-PAGE:
  - Load 20-30 μg protein per well
  - Include protein ladder in first lane
  - Run at 80-120V until dye front reaches bottom

Transfer to Membrane:
  - Activate PVDF membrane in methanol (1 min)
  - Rinse in transfer buffer
  - Assemble transfer sandwich (sponge-paper-gel-membrane-paper-sponge)
  - Transfer at 100V for 1-2 hours (or overnight at 30V)
  - Optional: Stain membrane with Ponceau S to verify transfer

Blocking:
  - Wash membrane briefly in TBST
  - Block in 5% milk/BSA in TBST for 1 hour at room temperature
  - Shake gently on orbital shaker

Primary Antibody Incubation:
  - Prepare primary antibody in blocking buffer (check datasheet for dilution)
  - Incubate overnight at 4°C with gentle shaking
  - OR 2 hours at room temperature

Washing:
  - Wash 3 times with TBST, 5-10 minutes each
  - Shake gently during washes

Secondary Antibody Incubation:
  - Prepare HRP-conjugated secondary antibody in blocking buffer (typically 1:5000 to 1:10000)
  - Incubate 1-2 hours at room temperature with shaking

Final Washing:
  - Wash 3-4 times with TBST, 5-10 minutes each
  - Final rinse with TBS (no Tween)

Detection:
  - Apply ECL substrate according to manufacturer instructions
  - Incubate for recommended time (usually 1-5 minutes)
  - Image immediately using chemiluminescence imager
  - Capture multiple exposures

fields.observations:
- Record images of blot
- Note signal intensity
- Document any background or non-specific bands
- Note loading control results
